## Current position

**Postdoctoral Research Associate**, with Prof. Oliver Shorttle  
Department of Earth Sciences, University of Cambridge · Nov 2023 – present

- *Jan 2026 – present.* Carbon isotope methods on olivine and plagioclase inclusions at MORB to understand volatile behaviour in spreading-ridge cumulates.
- *Oct 2025 – present.* Leading experimental petrology on hydrothermal vents as prebiotic environments — testing scenarios linking volcanism and deep volatile cycles to the origins of life.
- *Nov 2023 – Sep 2025.* Developed a high-precision SIMS method for concurrent C concentration and δ¹³C in basaltic glasses; revised the carbon isotope composition of the upper mantle and the deep primordial reservoir using olivine-hosted melt inclusions.

## Previous appointments

**Postdoctoral Research Associate**, with Dr Simon Hunt  
Department of Materials, University of Manchester · Sep 2022 – Nov 2023

- High-pressure experiments under stress applicable to convection in the transition zone; machine-learning-enhanced processing of spectral data on experimental charges.
- Characterised the rheology of Co₂SiO₄ at 4 GPa under stress; developed a statistical workflow for processing XRF and EDS spectral mapping on experimental charges.

**Engineering Geologist**  
Pells Sullivan Meynink, Sydney · Mar 2019 – Sep 2019

- Geotechnical site investigation for the Rozelle Interchange (Westconnex tunnel system). Supervised drill rigs; performed ¹⁴C dating of sediments.

## Teaching

**Demonstrator**, Earth Sciences, University of Cambridge · 2024 – present.  
Part IB *Earth Sciences B* and Part II *Earth Sciences*. Classes up to 30 students. Modules: subsurface processes of the lithosphere and asthenosphere; origin and composition of rocky planets; differentiation of the Earth; melting, metamorphism, and convection. Igneous-petrology module on global MORB systematics, mantle heterogeneity, magma storage, and mantle-temperature estimation using data-science techniques in Python.

**Undergraduate supervisions**, King's & Jesus Colleges, University of Cambridge · 2024 – present.  
Weekly small-group teaching (≤4 students) covering Part IB *Earth Sciences B*: igneous and metamorphic petrology, phase diagrams.

**Demonstrator**, Earth and Planetary Sciences, Macquarie University · 2017 – 2022.  
*Introduction to Oceanography* (1st year), *Geology of Australia* (2nd year). Practicals, fieldwork, marking.
